title: Content Tracker config
description: What to track, and where. Only settings.files.dirs and where it's tracked are needed: everything else has a default.

files.description: The folders to scan, and what's tracked from them.

rootPath.description: Taken off the start of every path, so it doesn't matter where the folders are on each computer.

frequency.description: Seconds between scans, or 0 to scan once and stop.

rules.description: Which folders and files are tracked, as globs like *.mov or regular expressions written /like this/, matched against the path as it's tracked.

mediaMetadata.description: Read media files' details, like duration and resolution, with ffprobe.

limitToFirstFile.description: Only track the first file in each folder that the rules allow, like the first image of a sequence.

trackFolders.description: Also track the folders, with linked records to the files. Off tracks only the files.

concurrency.description: How many files are looked at at once.

removing.description: What happens to the records of files and folders that have gone.

enabled.description: Remove them. Off keeps them, for when media is cleared off a drive but should still be listed. -nd turns it off for a run.

confirm.description: Warn before removing more than 10% of a table. -nc turns it off for a run.

token.description: A personal access token, if you haven't signed in. AIRTABLE_API_KEY is used over it.

base.description: The base's ID, app followed by 14 letters and numbers.

foldersTable.description: The folders table's name or ID. A name that isn't there is created.

filesTable.description: The files table's name or ID. A name that isn't there is created.

view.description: A view to compare against, rather than the whole table.

spreadsheetId.description: The spreadsheet's link, or its ID.

credentials.description: A service account's key, if you haven't signed in. GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is used over it.

foldersSheet.description: The folders tab's name, created if it isn't there.

filesSheet.description: The files tab's name, created if it isn't there.

includes.description: Only what matches one of these is tracked. Empty tracks everything.

excludes.description: What matches any of these isn't tracked.

includes.description: Only what matches one of these is tracked. Empty tracks everything.

excludes.description: What matches any of these isn't tracked. Leave it out and the Mac's .DS_Store files aren't.
